sources.title: Allen AI Model Lineage 2026: OLMo, Molmo, Tulu - Presenc AI
sources.snippet: The Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) in Seattle is the world\u2019s leading fully-open AI lab, releasing model families with open weights, open training data, and open training code. The 2026 Ai2 lineage spans OLMo 2 (language), Molmo (vision-language), Tulu 3 (post-training recipe), and SciFive (scientific).
